name: What factors influence the cost of ADU architectural planning?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of ADU architectural planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of ADU architectural planning depends on several factors, including the size and complexity of the ADU design, the level of detail required for permits, and site-specific challenges. For example, a two-story ADU or one built on a sloped lot will typically incur higher planning costs than a simple detached garage conversion. The amount of custom design work versus using pre-approved plans also plays a significant role in the overall planning expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU architectural planning costs are influenced by unit size, design complexity, permit detail requirements, and site challenges like sloped lots.
